about: Pairs of condition names that are NOT merged by rule (feeltriva_api.duplicates), although a reference list matches both names to one entry. Each stays a pair for a clinician's explicit decision. Written by the engineering assistant, who is not a clinician: the reason says why the assistant hesitated, not what is medically true.

not_merged.reason: one reference entry lists both names, but croup is commonly described as an illness of young children and laryngitis as an inflammation of the voice box at any age; the assistant is not sure they are one condition
sickle cell anemia is commonly described as one form of sickle cell disease, not as another name for all of it; the assistant is not sure they are one condition
